Findings: C2-055 AttachUnknownFace says "binding entry" (payload holds the binding type; low confidence), C2-073 BindingContractMismatch payload lists trait, method and direction (struct holds binding, reason, observed), C2-139 UninitializedInputs is called collected (code throws it fail-fast, test_conditions.jl:269; spec 13521 and 17184 say collected too), C2-299 EntryTypeMismatch lists the value's type as a separate item (no such field). The one lead (dt_unit) is a glossary anchor, g-dt_unit exists at spec.md:16481 (C2-038). The range holds no Julia code block. Probe at /Users/miguel/.julia/dev/Redstone.jl/design/reports/20261124_doc_conformance/probes/C2/probe.jl, run three times. Not exercised in a run, settled by reading code and tests: the DeploymentInvalid lattice :range arms on Δt_base and h_max (test/test_lattices.jl:514-530 covers them), ReadResolution reasons beyond code reading (my series probe misused the API), CheckpointMidFrame on a stopped sim. Side notes, no row: MissingInit under replay! is raised only with restore = false (sim.jl:1344). The probe showed Absolute's :range carries no argument name, and the spec ties "with the argument named" to :inexact only, so no finding. Evidence 'probe:N' is a line of that probe script.
